payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes total arrays m^1+...+m^n modulo, then subtracts non-ambiguous arrays count using product of floor(m / primorial(i)) for i up to min(n,36).
payload.rationale: The solution is a direct mathematical formula, not DP. Chose dp_counting_combinatorics as it is the only DP subtype related to counting problems; others involve DP states not present.
